newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Washington rules out direct response after Iraq sent its helicopters to pick up its pilgrims from Saudi Arabia.
- Moroccan contractors and banks to set up a fund for real estate investment in Jerusalem.
- Egypt and Japan sign agreement to finance irrigation plants.
- A Lebanese industrial team seeks renewing contracts worth $100 million with Iraqi busimessmen.
- Kuwait Industrial Bank granted loans worth $51.5 million to 15 industrial projects in Kuwait in 1996, report says.
- Abu Dhabi emirate of the United Arab Emirates launches privatising water and electricity projects by offering a 2.7 billion dirham project to the private sector, sources say.
